_how: Home page hero picture by date, Chicago time. The first season whose dates include today wins; a range may run across New Year (from 11-01 to 03-31). Any other day gets the default. Each name is two files in web_assets/brand: NAME.jpg and NAME.webp, both 1024 by 572. A season whose files are missing is skipped, so a typo here can never blank the hero. The site is static: the picture changes with the first build on or after the date, and the feed job builds most days.
